All 14 queries ran and gave plausible answers. I checked the two CSV totals by hand and they match. I didn't hand-check the others, and I didn't test cases the sample data doesn't contain.

T1: `/data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | filter ~(/email | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count`
T2: `/data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)`
T3: `/data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count)`
T4: `/data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2`
T5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels | map ~(/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort`
T6: `sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)})`
T7: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count)`
T8: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~([(/0 | keyword) /1]) | sort ~(/0) | map ~(join "@")`
T9: `/services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","`
T10: `lines | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2) | map ~(count)`
T11: `lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | first | split "=" | /1 | parseJson) | avg | round 1`
T12: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split "," | :c / | {:customer (c | /1) :qty (c | /3 | parseJson) :price (c | /4) :status (c | /5 | lower)}) | filter ~(/price | ne "") | filter ~(/status | eq "shipped") | map ~(mulOf /qty (/price | parseJson)) | sum | round 2`
T13: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(trim | ne "") | map ~(split "," | :c / | {:customer (c | /1) :qty (c | /3 | parseJson) :price (c | /4) :status (c | /5 | lower)}) | filter ~(/price | ne "") | filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(map ~(mulOf /qty (/price | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries | map ~({:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1}) | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2`
